predictions.derivation_recorded: approximate functional equation for N >~ t/2pi: zeta(s) ~ d_N(s) + N^{1-s}/(s-1); at a zero rho: d_N(rho) ~ -N^{1-rho}/(rho-1); shadow zero of d_N at rho + delta with delta ~ -d_N(rho)/d_N'(rho) ~ N^{1-rho}/((rho-1) zeta'(rho)); hence |delta| ~ sqrt(N)/(|rho-1| |zeta'(rho)|) (grows like sqrt N at fixed height) and arg delta ~ -gamma log N + const (rotates with N)
predictions.statement: at gamma = 40.918719, N in {10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 60}: |delta(N)|/sqrt(N) is constant to within +-30%, and arg delta(N) changes as -gamma log N (mod 2pi) to within +-0.3 rad.

predictions.mac_note_before_run: MAC flags a numerical concern registered BEFORE computing: in the tau-integral form (11) the integral int cos(tau log m) H(tau) dtau is a Fourier transform of H at frequency log m, whose true value decays doubly exponentially in log m (the tests (5) decay like exp(-a_n e^{2x})), while the integrand itself is O(1e3-1e6) on [-T_cut, T_cut]. The 5% change between m_max 8 and 32 seen in wn_hygiene.json is therefore suspected to be quadrature cancellation error, not a real arithmetic contribution. Before judging the m_max part MAC will implement the correlation form (9)/(10) (C_alpha beta(t), non-oscillatory) and cross-check the two forms against each other by Parseval at small m; the m_max part of this prediction is judged on the form that passes that cross-check.
